responses.text: Noted: booking TR-4471, two adults on the Isle of Carrow from 14 to 19 November 2026, with sea birds and quiet coves high on the list. I have your walk ideas too.
Thanks: vegetarian options for your sister and seafood for you, plus a camera kit for dawn on the cliffs. I will keep both in mind for the days you plan.
Noted your budget lines and your hopes for the inn and the evenings. Nothing here needs a lookup yet.
Thanks for the bird list; the binoculars to share are a good idea.
Noted your worries: a calm-weather plan B and seasickness tips are worth keeping for the crossing day.
I no longer have the key safe code from your first notes, so please send it again rather than have me guess it.
